name: Blue Hole Spring / Jug Spring, Ichetucknee
area: North end of Ichetucknee Springs State Park
coordinateNote: Approximate internal spring location, not a road entrance. Drive to the North Entrance shown on the official map, then follow Blue Hole Trail; do not navigate a vehicle to this pin.
navigationDestination: Ichetucknee Springs State Park North Entrance, 8294 SW Elim Church Road, Fort White FL
experience: Snorkel over a deep cyan spring opening, with fish and turtles and the cave entrance beginning about 40 feet below the surface. Blue Hole, also called Jug Spring, is the deep-hole experience beside Ichetucknee's shallower headspring. Reach it on the roughly half-mile woodland trail from the North Entrance. Strong flow makes this an experienced-swimmer stop; entering the cave requires the appropriate cave or cavern qualification.
cost: Same Ichetucknee park entry; not a separate park admission. Bring snorkel gear; current rental availability here not established.
access: Access on foot from North Entrance. Park map labels Blue Hole Trail 0.4 mile; amenities page describes a half-mile walk. No scuba elsewhere in Ichetucknee's springs/river.

conditions.summary: The state lists swimming at the North Entrance. A Blue Hole-specific reopening could not be verified. The separate posted closure is at Midpoint Tube Launch; check the ranger station before water entry.

water: Official educational page describes cyan clear water and strong flow; it is not a dated visibility measurement.
mobility: Forest walk plus deep-water entry; strong swimmers only per park. Do not treat recreational scuba certification as cave authorization.
